request.goal: Make a 20-second vertical story about the oak bowl: open with the finished bowl, then show how it is made.

notes: Timings are wall-clock measurements of this single run, including HTTP polling at 0.5 s intervals.
A local plan is deterministic signal analysis, not model understanding. Meta mode requires live credentials.

plan.title: Oak Bowl: From Blank to Table
plan.summary: Open on the finished oiled oak bowl, then trace its making from raw wet blank through lathe turning, sanding, and oil finish.

segments.label: Finished bowl
segments.reason: Opens with the finished bowl as brief requires. Visible card '1. Finished bowl' and finished piece. Speech evidence [0.0–2.7] and [2.7–5.0] describes it as finished, oiled and ready for the table.

segments.label: Raw blank
segments.reason: Shows starting material. Visible card '2. Raw oak'. Speech evidence [8.0–11.2] and [11.2–12.0] describes the raw oak blank, still wet and heavy.

segments.label: Turning
segments.reason: Shows shaping on the lathe. Visible card '3. Turning'. Speech evidence [16.0–18.8] and [18.8–20.0] describes shape appearing in long, steady cuts.

segments.label: Sanding
segments.reason: Shows smoothing step. Visible card '4. Sanding'. Speech evidence [24.0–26.4] and [26.4–29.0] describes sanding from coarse to fine with lathe turning slowly.

segments.label: Oil finish
segments.reason: Shows finishing step that leads to opening bowl. Visible card '5. Oil finish'. Speech evidence [32.0–35.1] describes a coat of food safe oil bringing out the color.

analysis_notes: Meta director selected the moments; scene cuts, speech bands and transcript come from local analysis.

review.verdict: Correct order and runtime, but hook and clarity fail: cropped opening title, no visible bowl payoff, and out-of-sync titles/subtitles confuse the story. Fix framing and sync then re-export.
review.caption_suggestion: Finished oak bowl to raw blank in 19s: turning, sanding, oil. Full build in order.
strengths: Hits target length at 19.1s for 20-second goal and keeps approved 5-beat order.
Numbered step cards give clear structure: finished, raw, turning, sanding, oil.
Concise process narration supports how-it-is-made story without extra filler.

fixes.what: Reframe opening hero - at start text is cropped to '. Finished bow' on flat color with no bowl visible. Re-export full vertical framing to show finished bowl + full '1. Finished bowl' title.
Fix Step 2 label / narration mismatch - card reads '2. Raw oak' while subtitle says 'This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table'. Align title, voice and picture to raw blank.
Fix subtitle bleed into finale - '5. Oil finish' card still carries 'Sanding going goes from coarse to fine...' text. Trim / re-time captions so each step has its own line.
